author: Tu_Gordito
quote:
Let's be honest here. I have to point 2 good aspects of the game first. 
The graphics are incredible, the face animations, the cars, shadows, reflexes, everything looks so beautiful.
GTA VI has one of the best if not the best open world at the moment, and it will be difficult to match this in a near future.

Now let's start the real review.
Gameplay is just GTA V with a few extras, anything new or innovative, just the same formula as GTA IV that followed with GTA V. The physical combat is straight up ripped off from rdr2, nothing else.
The story is one of the worst stories that Rockstar has offered through the years. No character development, and no real personality between the protagonists. Jason and Lucía relationship is just... A pretty cliché relationship outside of the crime scene.

The release has been horrible, full of bugs, comparable to Cyberpunk 2077 release. This is unacceptable in a 13 year wait videogame with a 2 Billion budget. It is not unplayable, but bugs and glitches are recurrent and they lower the quality of the game a lot.

Lastly, the FPS rate. I am not really complaining about 30 fps, I think that if managed correctly they look fine, for example, the Switch 1 version of BOTW. But here, frame drops are constant on a PS5 and even thought it is true that in PS5 Pro they are more stable, it still drops a lot in gunfights or crowd areas.

This is not the game we expected and deserved for almost 100€ and a 13 years wait, we are dissappointed.
